body:
## Problem
PR #71 and #80 address different causes but conflict in `GlobalDSP.h` and the native integration test. #71 still fails macOS focused/product settling; #80 still fails four product routes. An accurate final pitch is not a timing PASS.

This Draft is stacked on #71 `fd1f222`. It ports #80's generation ownership without bringing back unrelated release documentation.

## Changes
- Keep #71's active macOS USER_INTERACTIVE / inactive DEFAULT QoS, estimator and complete timing attribution.
- Replace first-activation special casing and blanket generation-transition FIFO discard with #80's per-sample generation filtering and producer-side input-gap invalidation.
- Fix a further reproducible #80 defect: when the old input expires and a new producer generation is already queued, reset history but preserve that generation's fresh full window. Keep conservative discard when no generation changed.
- Add controlled re-enable, resumed-after-expiry and cold mixed-queue CTests. Retain the original 32-route gates, <290ms acquisition/settling, <0.1ct route accuracy, 250ms stale policy and 1,105 frozen estimator comparisons.
- Preserve host parameters/state, strobe, TT/BFTS, version/expiry and publication policy.
- Preserve complete historical macOS CTest excerpts, all 96 route rows, hashes, new A/B controls and local raw CTest output.

## Reproducible evidence
| Controlled real-JUCE regression | Original | Integrated local |
|---|---|---|
| #71 re-enable with queued complete window | FAIL (no acquisition) | PASS, 122.386ms |
| #80 expiry + fresh generation | FAIL (no acquisition) | PASS, 172.423ms |

These controlled single-window figures are not realtime/DAW latency qualification. Historical macOS timing also contains worker/feeder scheduling delays and remains a separate acceptance concern.

Local Release CMake/JUCE: **8/8 CTests, 32/32 routes PASS**; max acquisition **194.542407ms**, max settling **205.167074ms**. Pure tests retain **576 pitch + 18 stress + 1,105 exact kernel comparisons**. Sources under compatibility inspection are byte-identical to #71.

## Exact-source native CI
Source: `0f859400abfb944fc99ea9cfab842c77a6851a50`.
Tree: `a44a8082b1101f3b80bcb7a976d7b984cbf91b0f`, verified equal to the locally tested tree.

Focused tuner (three until-fail executions), full Product, and graphical-EQ workflows check out this PR head SHA. Native runs registered for this exact source:
- [Focused tuner + native integration](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38893218198)
- [Full Product matrix](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38893218319)
- [Independent graphical EQ](https://github.com/raven-deadwire/SpectralForge-Chimera-Amp-Matrix/actions/runs/38893218344)

At the initial checkpoint these runs are queued/in progress; no native PASS claim. The source branch will stay fixed while they run. Raw FEED/TIMING/DIAGNOSTICS, failed routes, JUnit and LastTest logs remain uploaded even on failure. No until-pass rerun or relaxed gate.
